title: Keto Moroccan Turnip Puffs
description: A crispy, cheesy, and flavorful keto dish that combines the earthy taste of turnips with the spices of Morocco.
instructions: 2. Peel and chop turnips into small pieces.
3. In a bowl, mix turnips with grated cheese and a pinch of salt.
4. Roll out briouat pastry and cut into squares.
5. Place a spoonful of turnip mixture onto each square, leaving a 1-inch border.
6. Fold the pastry squares in half to form a triangle, pressing edges to seal.
7. Place the puffs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
8. Brush the tops with a little water and sprinkle with paprika.
9. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
